name: Period Sweet Drops
source: In this fandisc for Period you can play new stories with all the main game's girls as well as Arisa, Hatsumi and Chitose, who didn't have their own stories in Period. Also, various fan materials are included.
translation: 这是《Period》的Fan Disc。除了主游戏所有女主角的新故事外，还收录了在《Period》中没有个人路线的亚莉莎、初实与千岁等人的故事，以及各种面向爱好者的附加内容。
